license.notes: Factory roadmap 267, the walker's look review of 2026-10-20 on arena_a02's four barrier volumes (3.0 x 0.8 x 1.2 m, built as boxes): 'Crowd rails (a new model)', not the jersey barrier. REFERENCE: a hot-dip galvanised steel crowd-control barricade -- one interlocking panel of 1-1/2 in tube legs and 1-1/4 in rails with 3/4 in pickets, fourteen to a 7.5 ft panel, the bottom rail 8 in up, on two flat-bar feet, hooks at one end that drop over the next panel's leg. The defaults are the common fabricated sizes, 7.5 ft x 43 in on 24 in feet; the ranges hold arena_a02's slot (`core/crowd_barrier_forms.py`). One material. Collision: the panel; Deli Counter writes its volume's own collider in the greybox. BUILT: 412 tris at the default dims, 476 at arena_a02's, 508 at the largest corner (2026-10-20).
